_input.situation: Maya, 34, is told by her manager in a team meeting that the project she led for eight months is being cancelled. Six colleagues are present. Her manager says 'it's nobody's fault, priorities shifted.' It is 4:40pm; she skipped lunch.

formative_events.description: parents emphasized not causing shame to the family in public

beliefs_about_situation: believes the project was on track
did not know cancellation was being considered

question.text: Will Maya object or push back during the meeting?

cognition.inner_speech: Eight months. In front of everyone. Don't react, don't react. Why didn't he tell me first?
cognition.attention_on: the faces of the six peers; whether her own face is composed
goals_activated: preserve composure in front of peers
find out what was really decided and by whom
cognition.stated_reason_likely: I'm fine, these things happen; I just wish I'd had more notice so the team could plan.
cognition.narrative_gap: omits the public humiliation (face value, family shame history) and the RAGE at the manager; frames as a process complaint

candidates.action: stays silent or says 'understood', asks one logistical question
asks pointed but polite questions about who decided and when
openly objects or shows visible anger

action.most_likely: Composed, minimal verbal response in the meeting; requests a one-on-one with the manager afterwards; eats something or vents to a trusted colleague within the hour; updates job search within days.
action.expressed_vs_felt: High suppression plus a peer audience plus a face-oriented upbringing means the expressed state is neutral-professional while the felt state is anger and humiliation.

counterfactuals.effect_on_action: pushback probability rises sharply; humiliation drops
irritation and suspicion lower; composure easier
visible objection becomes the modal response

counterfactuals.change: manager had warned her a week earlier
counterfactuals.effect_on_action: novelty and shock near zero; disappointment remains

evidence.driver: public audience + face value + shame-avoidant upbringing -> suppression of objection
goal blocked by an agent -> anger; agency partly circumstance -> frustration
violated expectation (routine meeting) -> high novelty, shock
8 hours without food, 6 hours sleep -> raised irritability and threat sensitivity
high conscientiousness + achievement value -> loss weighted heavily
status asymmetry with manager -> low control appraisal, resentment rather than confrontation
